AC EVIDENCE, verified against merged main (Gerrit 2078, commit caad679cdcf).

AC1 completeness: pytest -k completeness PASSES (test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked).
AC2 empty tree: pytest -k empty_tree PASSES (test_empty_tree_every_guarded_step_skips_cleanly).
AC3 reasonless marker rejected: test_a_marker_without_a_reason_is_rejected PASSES.
AC4 dropped guard caught: test_a_step_that_drops_its_guard_is_caught PASSES.
All four in tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py: 4 passed.
AC6: both markers that cite a gap name a ticket, and BOTH links already exist - cushy-soldierly-sunbear (e818-564e-d3b6-4eaa) and marauding-hornblende-bluet (d93e-92ce-e2d0-4033), each linked discovered_from this ticket. Note for anyone re-checking: these are INBOUND links, so they do not appear in 'rebar deps 7e0d' outbound list; I initially misread their absence there as the criterion failing.

AC5 WAS NOT SATISFIABLE AS WRITTEN, and was corrected rather than ticked on a false claim. It required 'git diff origin/main -- .github/ showing only comment lines'. That can never hold for this change: attaching a '# predates-gate-ok:' comment INSIDE a step body forces that step's 'run:' from a plain scalar to a block scalar, so those lines necessarily appear. The complete set of non-comment lines in the landed diff is exactly three such conversions - mutation_gate.py, check_readme_quickstart.py and probe_rebar.py - each with byte-identical command text, a form GitHub Actions executes identically. The criterion has been reworded to state that real invariant, with tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py (24 passed, unchanged) as the behavioural check. This edit changes the description TEXT, so the plan-review attestation goes stale-material and a re-review is required before close; that cost is deliberate and preferable to ticking a criterion whose stated check is false.
